diagnostics.summary: call to `Output.write` uses an unnamed argument.
diagnostics.label: argument must be named
causes: Public, core, native, constructor, and protocol calls require named arguments. Constructor shorthand is only allowed for a bare identifier that matches a field name; positional arguments are only allowed for private helper calls and receiver-call shorthand.

fixes.title: Write the argument as `name: value`.

fixes.title: Add `message: ...` to the call.

diagnostics.summary: match scrutinee has type `JsonError`, expected `Option<T>`, `Result<T, E>`, `List<T>`, a declared sum/struct/class type, or an `Int`/`String`/`Char`/`Bool` literal match.
diagnostics.label: control-flow type mismatch
causes: RSScript v0.7 `match` is limited to review-visible `Option`, `Result`, declared sum/struct/class patterns, and simple scalar literal dispatch.

fixes.title: Match an `Option<T>`, `Result<T, E>`, declared sum value, or scalar literal value; otherwise rewrite this branch as `if`.

diagnostics.summary: match arm has type `Result<T, String>`, expected `fresh JsonValue` from the first produced arm.
diagnostics.label: match arm type mismatch
causes: A match expression must produce one compatible value type across every arm.

fixes.title: Return the same value type from every match expression arm.

diagnostics.summary: operator `<` has operands `Result<T, String>` and `Int`, expected numeric operands.
diagnostics.label: operator type mismatch
causes: RSScript operators have fixed built-in operand types and do not use implicit conversion or overload resolution.

fixes.title: Compare values of the same supported type, or call an explicit named conversion/function first.
